title: What's New: Power BI (for Subscription Billing) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to new Power BI app for subscription billing
Subscription billing overview and KPI dashboard
Churn analysis and recurring revenue metrics
Revenue development and churn decomposition reports
AI-assisted analysis and manual churn investigation
Revenue reports by item, customer, and sales staff

features.name: Power BI app for subscription billing
features.description: A new analytical Power BI application for the subscription billing module with KPI overview, drill-through capabilities to details, and multiple revenue and churn analysis reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Subscription billing overview page
features.description: Main overview page in the Power BI app showing recurring revenue, active customers, and various subscription metrics with KPI overview and drill-through to customer contact details.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Churn visual and analysis
features.description: A churn visual showing monthly churn rates and churn decomposition chart to understand different types of churn and downgrades with key contributors analysis.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1
caveats: AI explanation may not work well with flat datasets

features.name: Revenue year-over-year report
features.description: Report showing revenue tracked year-over-year to compare current year performance against previous year data.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1
caveats: Useful once sufficient data is available

features.name: Revenue development report
features.description: Report showing changes for new subscriptions, churn, and downgrades with color coding to visualize subscription changes.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Revenue by item report
features.description: Report showing monthly recurring revenue broken down by different items in subscriptions.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Revenue by customer report
features.description: Report showing monthly recurring revenue broken down by customer dimension.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Revenue by sales staff report
features.description: Report showing monthly recurring revenue sold by different salespeople with drill-through to transaction details and customer subscription contracts.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1

features.name: Revenue forecast report
features.description: Report providing forecast of future monthly revenue and costs based on sales forecast and cost forecast data.
features.status_evidence_quote: Note that this will be not released in April, but in 26.1
caveats: Does not take churn percentages into account
